title: Wellness Membership Sign-Up Requirements by Tier
content:
Who may join the Wellness Membership depends on age on the start date and, on some tiers, a clearance on file or a pool at the home clinic.

| Tier | Minimum age on the start date | Parent or guardian signs the agreement below | Medical or therapist clearance on file before the start | Home clinic must have a pool |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Gym Access Membership | 16 years | 18 years | No | No |
| Aquatic Access Membership | 16 years | 18 years | Yes | Yes |
| Wellness Essentials Membership | 16 years | 18 years | No | No |
| Wellness Plus Membership | 16 years | 18 years | Yes | No |
| Performance Membership | 14 years | 18 years | No | No |
| Performance Plus Membership | 14 years | 18 years | Yes | No |

## Points of judgement

- **Age** is the member's age in whole years on the start date of the membership, not on the date of signing.
- **Guardian signature**: for a member younger than 18, a parent or guardian signs the agreement.
- **Clearance**: the Aquatic Access Membership, the Wellness Plus Membership and the Performance Plus Membership need a medical or therapist clearance on file before the start.
- **Pool**: the Aquatic Access Membership needs a home clinic with a pool.

## Hypothetical sign-ups

| Applicant on the start date | Tier sought | Reading of the table |
|---|---|---|
| 15 years old | Open Gym Access Membership | below the minimum age of 16 |
| 15 years old | Performance Membership | meets the minimum age of 14; a parent or guardian signs |
| 16 years old | Wellness Essentials Membership | meets the minimum age of 16; a parent or guardian signs |
| 40 years old, no clearance on file | Wellness Plus Membership | a clearance on file is needed before the start |
| 40 years old, clearance on file, home clinic without a pool | Aquatic Access Membership | the home clinic must have a pool |
